statement: A durable mark-and-sweep owner reclaims sealed artifact payloads with no canonical references (installed service revisions, bindings, desired or running Cells, in-flight pinned invocations — with all service_revisions rows treated as retained rollback revisions) that are older than a named retention window, never uses a live reference counter, never deletes a payload reachable from any canonical reference, and is proven by deterministic tests covering reachable-payload immunity, retention-window enforcement, and concurrent-install safety.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
